query: What minimum detectable effect sizes can we expect in two-level multilevel models given N=300–350 teachers, ~30–40 schools, average cluster size 8–10, and ICCs in the 0.05–0.20 range? Show formulas.

response.query: What minimum detectable effect sizes can we expect in two-level multilevel models given N=300–350 teachers, ~30–40 schools, average cluster size 8–10, and ICCs in the 0.05–0.20 range? Show formulas.
response.answer: Minimum detectable effect sizes in two-level multilevel models depend on sample size, cluster size, and intraclass correlation; expect detectable effects around 0.15-0.25 given N=300-350, ~30-40 schools, average cluster size 8-10, and ICCs 0.05-0.20.
